T-theme-tokens-unusedinferred

Wix theme tokens defined but visually unapplied

Every page declares --wst-color-action / --wst-button-color-fill-primary = rgb(91,141,176) (#5b8db0); that blue never appears in the computed palette. The token layer is the Wix theme's, not the brand's.

Source: pages/*.json § customProps; _computed-styles.json § aggregate.colors
